cases.head: 8b53f176f1afc541d61a34310aa309a2c60f9b7a
cases.rationale: The change replaces the array classifier and object key collector. The saved checks exercise both array order and object-key order invariance.

cases.head: a6e8b00a39ee372fee9cbb0787826ff486c53bea
cases.rationale: Cycle handling needs a recursive reference and the cycles option. Neither saved cache-key check builds a cyclic input.

cases.head: 7135fba3f03c6f97d801047c53fab90c26aacfa8
cases.rationale: The public declaration now accepts primitive inputs. The saved cache-key tests check ordinary runtime object and array keys.

cases.head: 1b117480abdfe8d2a29d3ce9fefc46d7181ba2fa
cases.rationale: The change passes a property getter to a custom comparator. The existing key assertions use default canonical ordering and never install a comparator.

cases.head: c96707c5588ea957ada27be848b404eaa0013150
cases.rationale: Comparing row membership with and without filtering is a useful control. The saved case does not exercise the Java reader’s null filter configuration.

cases.head: 0e6eefba0889132c8554cec0ed437dcd3efaaade
cases.rationale: The defect concerns short reads of Bloom bitsets from an input stream. Row filtering never observes how many bitset bytes were read.

cases.head: 18c26d686d8ce716453b008a100b1aac351437fb
cases.rationale: Bloom writer paths must distinguish literal dots from nested column paths. The scan fixture writes no Bloom filters and has no colliding columns.

cases.head: de06c6fdf765b04b1993fe14b34286fefcfc329c
cases.rationale: Index-range short circuiting needs a column index and measurements of predicate evaluation. The existing scan experiment measures decoder row pruning.

cases.head: c14306cd98055dfb8e0680d2aa92f9e2dbadfa61
cases.rationale: The change adds TypeScript declarations. No saved runtime assertion checks type resolution or signatures.

cases.head: 1834d97a4c254ef95ecd537df85cd91703ad995a
cases.rationale: The engines field declares package compatibility. Stable hashing checks do not exercise package installation across Node versions.
